lines.say: Your city pays salaries in hours of life. Your boss just offered overtime.
One extra hour of work. Two hours added to your life. Easy.
Then rent comes due. One week of your life. Every month.
You walk past the rich block. Nobody there looks older than thirty.
The man at the top has been thirty years old since eighteen ninety.
Would you sell one hour of your life? Write it in the comments.
